items_all.title: 'Ghost Students' using AI to apply for student loans with stolen identities, DOJ's Operation Ghostbusters busts $200 million ring
items_all.summary: Fraudsters are using the identities of high school graduates who skipped college to apply for student loans and steal the excess proceeds that do not go to schools. They use AI to keep the charade going and make it seem like the fake student is actually going to class.

items_all.summary_zh: 诈骗者利用未上大学的高中毕业生的身份申请学生贷款，并窃取未用于学校的多余收入。他们使用人工智能来维持猜谜游戏的进行，让假学生看起来像是真的去上课了。
